Admission and Application Requirements for Atmospheric Earth Science
Admission Requirements
In addition to fulfilling admission requirements set by Graduate School, applicants must also have
1.a. Three semesters of calculus including the calculus of vector-valued functions, basic (ordinary) differential equations, and two semesters of calculus-based physics. Linear algebra is recommended. (MS AES/ATS and PhD ATS)
b. Two semesters of calculus, and two semesters of calculus-based physics. (MS AES/ESS)
c. Two semesters of calculus, and two semesters of calculus-based physics. Undergraduate course in Remote Sensing recommended. (Graduate GIS and Remote Sensing Certificate)
2. Demonstrable computer proficiency in at least one high-level programming language.
3. Minimum grade point average of 3.0 on the undergraduate record. For admission into the PhD ATS program, an MS degree in atmospheric science / meteorology or a broadly related STEM field is required.
APPLY FOR GRADUATE ADMISSION
Application Requirements
The application requirements for the Atmospheric and Earth Science graduate programs are as follows:
MS AES
Required:
1) Official college transcript
2) Three letters of recommendation
3) Personal statement
Optional:
Graduate Assistantship application
Resume / CV
GRE scores are not required.
PhD ATS
Required:
1) Official college transcripts for both Bachelor's and Master's degrees
2) Three letters of recommendation
3) Personal statement
Optional:
Graduate Assistantship application
Resume / CV
GRE scores strongly encouraged for PhD GRA consideration.
Graduate GIS & RS Certificate
Required:
1) Official college transcript
2) Curriculum vitae or resume
Additional Information
Letters of recommendation should be from instructors, capstone advisors, or project managers who can attest to your knowledge, skills, and abilities. Letters should be submitted via the graduate school application, but can also be sent to aes-chair@uah.edu.
For priority consideration of a graduate research assistantship (GRA) or graduate teaching assistantship (GTA), apply on or before January 1 (For Fall start).
We look forward to receiving your completed application, and we will give you full consideration for admissions into the UAH Department of Atmospheric & Earth Science. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at aes@uah.edu.
